description: adult man godlike ravager of war, huge and very muscular, long wild dark brown hair and a thick braided beard with iron rings, standing in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet and the whole weapon inside the image, about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, highly detailed pixel art with fine details, rich textures and ornaments, crisp clean outlines, legendary and majestic, far more powerful and richly equipped than an ordinary hero, a godlike ultimate form, grander and more radiant than any legendary hero, skin cracked with glowing molten red light like cooling lava, a crown of black horns, massive black and crimson armour plates with spikes and runes of fire on the shoulders and forearms, a tattered dark red war cape, a belt of iron skulls, holding a colossal double-bladed war axe wreathed in red fire with both hands, the whole axe inside the image, small embers drifting close to the axe, terrifying fury, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same man: the same face, hair and build, drawn the same way; now in a far grander, godlike outfit and weapon of the same kind, not this outfit
